title: skills(checklist-test): write the run close-out and re-test process into the skill — four-way disposition, record lifecycle, re-test triggers
body:
Blocked-by: #9387

Maintainer authorization (2026-08-18, PM chat, skills-seat session `session_01Rn7aaamsR99FXRqLcpL99q`): 「同意你的落地动作」, approving the QA management-loop design. This card lands the process text; it is blocked on #9387 because its PR #9470 edits the same file (`checklist-test/SKILL.md`) — hard same-file serial, and the close-out text must be written against the post-#9470 section structure (tiering, completion criteria).

## Content to land (design ruled in the 2026-08-18 discussion; zero new labels — every state uses existing carriers)

1. **Run close-out is part of every run** (extends the #9366 extraction duty): a `qa-run` record closes only after —
   - every `FAIL` gets a four-way disposition on the record's own evidence: product defect → independent bug card (dup-check, fix-landing repo, no pm labels, enters normal triage) / assertion defect → test-fix card in the owning repo / stale spec → re-point card / invalid pairing → blocked note, no card;
   - `PARTIAL` coverage gaps are either filed as per-area pin-upgrade cards or parked on the wave anchor — named, never dropped;
   - `NOT-RUN` keeps the handover list (already required);
   - the close-out comment is machine-greppable: `Extracted: …` / `Parked-on: …` / `Superseded-by: …` / `Carried-forward: …`.
   **Open `qa-run` count = outstanding close-out debt** — the health reading, same construction as bare `finding` count.
2. **Extracted-card traceability**: every card extracted from a run carries a body line `QA-source: #<run> · <area.item> · <clause>` — greppable, no label.
3. **Supersede protocol**: a re-run that re-covers an older record's ground closes the old one (not_planned + `Superseded-by:`), after carrying forward any verdict the new run did not re-derive.
4. **Re-test triggers**, three and only three: (a) release candidate → full Tier-1 re-run; (b) a QA-sourced fix card lands → the accepting seat appends the affected items to the wave anchor's re-test checklist (mirror of the cross-repo follow-up rule); (c) maintainer names a target.
5. **Record labels**: `qa-run` only (restate #9366; the e4e5c6e3-wave drift — `tests`/`tracking`/`bug` on records — is the counter-example).

ADR-class: draft PR, human merge. Chinese instruction text, English machine criteria. Watch the register of the existing file — land rows in its actual structure.
